title: medicine
description:
Medicine — a soft brutalist cabin on the ridge in Pegram, TN, wrapped in bluff views and rare Tennessee biodiversity. Fog-soaked mornings, star-filled nights, and forest as far as you can see. Stone, metal, and wood throughout — nothing decorative, everything grounding. Soak in the pool, sweat in the cedar sauna, cook by induction or custom gas grill. A place to disconnect from the noise and reconnect with yourself and the people you love.
